passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and take from them twelve staffs, one from the leader of each tribe. Write each man’s name on his staff, and write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi, because there must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD commanded Moses to collect staffs from the Israelites.
Moses must take one staff from each tribe.
Each staff must come from the leader of that tribe.
There are twelve tribes.
Moses must collect twelve staffs in total.
Moses must write each leader’s name on his staff.
Moses must write Aaron’s name on the staff of Levi.
There must be one staff for the head of each tribe.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְקַ֣ח מֵֽאִתָּ֡ם מַטֶּ֣ה מַטֶּה֩ לְבֵ֨ית אָ֜ב מֵאֵ֤ת כָּל־ נְשִֽׂיאֵהֶם֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ שְׁמ֔וֹ תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל־ מַטֵּֽהוּ׃ וְאֵת֙ שֵׁ֣ם אַהֲרֹ֔ן תִּכְתֹּ֖ב עַל־ מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֑י כִּ֚י מַטֶּ֣ה אֶחָ֔ד לְרֹ֖אשׁ בֵּ֥ית אֲבוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting in front of the Testimony, where I meet with you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command.
God told Moses to take the staffs.
God told Moses to place the staffs in the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the holy place where God meets with Moses.
God told Moses to put the staffs in front of the Testimony.
The Testimony is the special sign of God's covenant.
God meets with Moses at this place.
passages.original: וְהִנַּחְתָּ֖ם בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לִפְנֵי֙ הָֽעֵד֔וּת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לָכֶ֖ם שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: The staff belonging to the man I choose will sprout, and I will rid Myself of the constant grumbling of the Israelites against you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God is the Lord of Israel.
God said He would choose one man.
God said the staff of the man He chooses will sprout.
God said this sign will show His choice.
God said He will stop the Israelites from complaining against Moses and Aaron.
God said the Israelites complain often.
God said He will end their grumbling with this sign.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֗ה הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אֶבְחַר־ בּ֖וֹ מַטֵּ֣הוּ יִפְרָ֑ח וַהֲשִׁכֹּתִ֣י מֵֽעָלַ֗י אֶת־ תְּלֻנּוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲשֶׁ֛ר הֵ֥ם מַלִּינִ֖ם עֲלֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses spoke to the Israelites, and each of their leaders gave him a staff—one for each of the leaders of their tribes, twelve staffs in all. And Aaron’s staff was among them.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses spoke to all the Israelites.
Each tribe of Israel had a leader.
Each leader gave Moses one staff.
There were twelve tribes.
There were twelve leaders.
Moses received twelve staffs in total.
Aaron was a leader from the tribe of Levi.
Aaron’s staff was included with the other staffs.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וַיִּתְּנ֣וּ אֵלָ֣יו׀ כָּֽל־ נְשִֽׂיאֵיהֶ֡ם מַטֶּה֩ לְנָשִׂ֨יא אֶחָ֜ד מַטֶּ֨ה לְנָשִׂ֤יא אֶחָד֙ לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֔ם שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר מַטּ֑וֹת וּמַטֵּ֥ה אַהֲרֹ֖ן בְּת֥וֹךְ מַטּוֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Then Moses placed the staffs before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Moses took the staffs from the leaders of the tribes.
Moses placed the staffs before the LORD.
The LORD’s presence was in the Tent of the Testimony.
Moses put the staffs inside the Tent of the Testimony.
passages.original: וַיַּנַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־ הַמַּטֹּ֖ת לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בְּאֹ֖הֶל הָעֵדֻֽת׃

passages.text: The next day Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony and saw that Aaron’s staff, representing the house of Levi, had sprouted, put forth buds, blossomed, and produced almonds.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
Aaron was from the tribe of Levi.
The Tent of the Testimony was a holy place where God’s presence was.
The next day, Moses entered the Tent of the Testimony.
Aaron’s staff was there.
Aaron’s staff represented the house of Levi.
Moses saw Aaron’s staff.
Aaron’s staff had sprouted.
Aaron’s staff had put forth buds.
Aaron’s staff had blossomed.
Aaron’s staff had produced almonds.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֣י מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת וַיָּבֹ֤א מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־ אֹ֣הֶל הָעֵד֔וּת וְהִנֵּ֛ה פָּרַ֥ח מַטֵּֽה־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן לְבֵ֣ית לֵוִ֑י וַיֹּ֤צֵֽא פֶ֙רַח֙ וַיָּ֣צֵֽץ צִ֔יץ וַיִּגְמֹ֖ל שְׁקֵדִֽים׃

passages.text: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from the LORD’s presence to all the Israelites. They saw them, and each man took his own staff.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD is God.
Moses took all the staffs from the LORD’s presence.
He brought the staffs to all the Israelites.
All the Israelites saw the staffs.
Each man took his own staff.
passages.original: וַיֹּצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּטֹּת֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶֽל־ כָּל־ בְּנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּרְא֥וּ וַיִּקְח֖וּ אִ֥ישׁ מַטֵּֽהוּ׃ס

passages.text: The LORD said to Moses, “Put Aaron’s staff back in front of the Testimony, to be kept as a sign for the rebellious, so that you may put an end to their grumbling against Me, lest they die.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD told Moses to take Aaron’s staff.
Aaron’s staff belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The LORD told Moses to put Aaron’s staff in front of the Testimony.
The Testimony was the sacred place where God’s presence was.
The LORD wanted the staff kept there as a sign.
The sign was for the rebellious people.
The LORD wanted to stop the people’s complaints against Him.
The LORD did not want the people to die because of their grumbling.
passages.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה הָשֵׁ֞ב אֶת־ מַטֵּ֤ה אַהֲרֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הָעֵד֔וּת לְמִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת לְא֖וֹת לִבְנֵי־ מֶ֑רִי וּתְכַ֧ל תְּלוּנֹּתָ֛ם מֵעָלַ֖י וְלֹ֥א יָמֻֽתוּ׃

passages.text: So Moses did as the LORD had commanded him.
passages.sermon:
Moses was the leader of the Israelites.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
Moses obeyed the LORD.
Moses did exactly what the LORD told him to do.
passages.original: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ מֹשֶׁ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֹת֖וֹ כֵּ֥ן עָשָֽׂה׃ס

passages.text: Then the Israelites declared to Moses, “Look, we are perishing! We are lost; we are all lost!
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Moses.
They said, “Look, we are dying.
We are lost.
All of us are lost.”
passages.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר הֵ֥ן גָּוַ֛עְנוּ אָבַ֖דְנוּ כֻּלָּ֥נוּ אָבָֽדְנוּ׃

passages.text: Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die. Are we all going to perish?”
passages.sermon:
The Israelites spoke to Moses.
They said, “Anyone who comes near the tabernacle of the LORD will die.
Are we all going to die?
Will we all perish?”
passages.original: כֹּ֣ל הַקָּרֵ֧ב׀ הַקָּרֵ֛ב אֶל־ מִשְׁכַּ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה יָמ֑וּת הַאִ֥ם תַּ֖מְנוּ לִגְוֺֽעַ׃ס
